discordlogin-loginbutton: Label of the login button on Special:UserLogin.
discordlogin-error-state: Error when the OAuth state check fails.
discordlogin-error-denied: Error when the user cancels on Discord.
discordlogin-error-discord: Error when Discord's API fails. $1 is a short reason.
discordlogin-error-notmember: Error when the user isn't in the required Discord server.
discordlogin-error-pending: Error when the user hasn't passed the server's membership screening.
discordlogin-error-config: Error when required settings are missing.
discordlogin-error-noname: Error when no valid username can be made.
